name: two_tanks_connected_valve_r12
title: Two rigid tanks connected by a valve: change of quality of R12
summary: Two rigid tanks of 200 L connected by a valve: tank A holds an R12 liquid-vapour mixture at 25 C (10 % liquid and 90 % vapour in volume) and tank B is empty; opening the valve lets saturated vapour into B at constant temperature until the pressures are equal. The model gives the initial and the final quality of tank A (change of +6.67 percentage points) and the liquid/vapour distribution of the whole volume.

origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquée (ULiège, MECA0002), repetition session 1, exercise 4 (2022-2023)

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (27 variables, all in common with the model), converted with --ees-units; additionally the companion Python/CoolProp solution of the same exercise (course folder Python/ThAp21_R01E04.py), reproduced by hand
verification.notes: '27 common variables, 12 differ (rtol=0.001)', largest relative deviation 1.97e-2 (Deltax_A). The whole deviation comes from the saturated vapour specific volume of R12 at 25 C (v_v, +1.06 % in CoolProp w.r.t. EES; v_l agrees to 8e-5); substituting the two EES property values into the model reproduces the stored EES solution to 2.09e-10 (6 differ at rtol=1e-12), so the equations are transcribed exactly. 25 C is 14 K below the critical temperature of R12 (39.4 C), where ees_import.md section 11 allows a few %. Manual unit conversion: process temperature only (K -> C); volumes, masses and all other quantities were already SI. The commit part of coolsolve_version is the one recorded by the other models of roadmap batch B-05: this checkout of the CoolSolve repository has no .git directory, so git rev-parse cannot be run.
